Washington will serve as the designated home team as both franchises look to make an early-season statement on the international stage. The Commanders arrive with Jayden Daniels at the centre of an offense built around his dual-threat ability, while Indianapolis will hope its quarterback situation and offensive playmakers can generate consistency against Washington’s defense. With the unique atmosphere of Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and both teams crossing the Atlantic for an uncommon interconference meeting, the first London game of the 2026 season adds an extra layer of intrigue to an already important early-season contest.
